description: This is a 1.21.1 neoforge mod that allows player to customize the air pressure changes in Create:Aeronautics

mods.name: Fly Higher
mods.description: Adjusts the air pressure curve for Create Aeronautics, with per-dimension physics and optional dynamic weather pressure.

releases.notes:
### 1.2.1

- Dynamic weather pressure is now **opt-in and disabled by default**.
- Enable it with weatherPressure = true in config/flyhigher.json or the Cloth Config screen.
- Existing 1.2.0 configs are migrated to the new default once.
- When enabled, rain uses ainPressureMultiplier (default 0.90) and thunderstorms use 	hunderPressureMultiplier (default 0.75), evaluated in real time without /reload.

Requires Create Aeronautics / Sable 2.0.6 on NeoForge 1.21.1.

mods.name: Fly Higher
mods.description: Adjusts the air pressure curve for Create Aeronautics, with per-dimension and dynamic weather pressure.

releases.notes:
### 1.2.0

- Dynamic weather pressure: rain lowers air pressure and thunderstorms lower it further, evaluated at read time so no /reload is needed.
- New config options: weatherPressure, ainPressureMultiplier (default 0.90) and 	hunderPressureMultiplier (default 0.75).
- Per-node altitude limit raised from 2,048 m to 20,000 m for high-altitude aircraft.
- Weather pressure also drives the Altitude Sensor's air-pressure readout.

Requires Create Aeronautics / Sable 2.0.6 on NeoForge 1.21.1.

mods.name: Fly Higher
mods.description: Adjusts the air pressure curve for Create Aeronautics, in every dimension and on the Altitude Sensor readouts.

releases.notes:
### 1.1.0

- Pressure curve now applies to dimensions without their own Sable dimension_physics entry, with the 1.0 atm anchor at that dimension's sea level.
- Altitude Sensor air-pressure readout now follows the same per-dimension curve; height remains true world Y.
- New `[dimensions] adaptOtherDimensions` config option.

Requires Create Aeronautics (Sable 2.0.6) on NeoForge 1.21.1.
